# thwip

> Commit-carried CI evidence for agent-run pipelines. Agents run CI where the
> code lives, sign a compact proof of the exact Git tree, and a
> ruleset-protected GitHub check verifies it in seconds. Thwip Queue merges on
> that proof; nothing reruns in the cloud.

## Install

Canonical source: [Developer setup](https://thwip.ai/install.md)

The CLI is on npm as `@recallnet/thwip`. The installed command is `thwip`;
`npx @recallnet/thwip` works without a global install. Node 22 or newer.

Steps:

1. Install the CLI: `npm install -g @recallnet/thwip`.
2. Sign in: `thwip login` prints a URL and a short code. You approve it in
   your own browser.
3. Register a signing key: `thwip keys status` says which key would sign and
   whether GitHub lists it. Register the public half with GitHub as a
   "Signing Key". GitHub defaults to "Authentication Key", which thwip does
   not read.
4. Report back the fingerprint, the GitHub account, and the key file.

## Profiles

Security profiles per project: fast, fresh, remote, audited. The FAQ defines
each one and when to use it: https://thwip.ai/faq.md

## Facts

Everything below is stated here because no other page states it. Anything
that gets a canonical home elsewhere leaves this section and becomes a link.

- Thwip Queue merges from the control plane on the App's contents write. It
  composes the commit on the base it verified and moves the branch without
  force. The repository holds no merge workflow and no branch-write secret.
- Plans: Free covers 3 projects and 5 signers. Pro is $5 a month or $50 a
  year and covers 15 projects and 25 signers. Verification is identical on
  both.
